headline: GAC to Produce Vehicles in Brazil with $1.3 Billion Investment by 2030
summary: Chinese automaker GAC plans to begin manufacturing cars in Goiás, Brazil, targeting 50,000 vehicles sold in 2027 as part of a $1.3 billion investment by 2030.
why: Cross-border automotive investments reflect automakers' expansion strategies into major emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector Brazil
impacts.why: New manufacturing plants increase local industrial capacity and competitive intensity in the regional automotive market.
